scope.method: Original pixels first, reference-only overlays for row correspondence, then detailed original-pixel crops on proposed omissions/identity changes. No model predictions used.
scope.limit: Focused omission/identity/occlusion review; not a complete redraw or certification of all 1031 rows, all 137 training images, or all endpoints.
